entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding! My name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hi Steve. I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I recently bought. I need to make a return.
Okay, I can definitely help with that. Let me just pull up your account here... one moment... Ah, I see you're a VIP member. Thank you for your loyalty!
Yes, I've been with you guys for a while. So, is the return possible? I've had it for a little over two weeks.
Absolutely, **no problem** at all. Our return policy is good for a full **90 days**, so you are well within the timeframe. I can get that started for you right now.
Oh, that's fantastic! I was worried I might have missed the window.

Not at all! And since you're a VIP, I'm going to go ahead and email you a pre-paid **return label**, so there's no shipping cost for you. I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase with us.
Wow, really? That's very generous. Thank you so much for making this so easy.
It's my pleasure. You should see that email in your inbox within the next five minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, Steve.
Happy to hear it! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
